checks.rationale: AC1/AC2 fail for the existing source policy and an accepted zero-invocation effective-policy snapshot; both independently reproduced. Identity, current-base hashes, clean scope, r4 approval and accepted TASK-004 ancestry verified. Reviewer rank 4 exceeds implementation rank 3; native selection provenance and unavailable provider confirmation are recorded honestly.

REQ-01/REQ-08 and preserved .ai compatibility are incomplete: known source policy cannot load and effective snapshot violates v1. No concrete provider, credential, remote, new-schema or persistence implementation was introduced.
Traced immutable installation/policy/model loading, binding lookup, overrides and hydration. Findings 001/002 break actual source loading and schema-valid effective policy generation.

Malformed/missing configuration, incompatible status, stale installation, broader overrides and unsafe paths have explicit non-retryable domain failures. Read-only filesystem operations acquire no persistent resources; real external junction is rejected.

Namespace, path, ownership, model, sandbox and strict saved-payload boundaries mostly work; existing local_containers and zero-invocation snapshot boundaries fail. Positive saved hydration remains portable and ignores changed defaults.

Declared exact-worktree suite passes 27 tests and covers meaningful failures, but the synthetic source fixture misses actual source policy and zero invocation is asserted without effective-policy schema validation. Independent probes produced 4 positive checks, 31 expected rejections and 2 defects.

Bounded configuration decoding only. Saved non-record payload IO/hash verification remains TASK-009/034 through existing references. Actual v1 configuration schemas have no project command-reference field; plan command DTOs/argv stay with TASK-002/006. No invented workflow-run fields or concrete dispatch.

Exact base/head diff contains only three added owned paths: configuration module, its isolated unit tests and task handoff; no unrelated or prohibited changes. Source clean before and after validation.

Exact frozen load_project_settings(root: Path, installation: InstallationRecord) -> ProjectSettings signature verified. Explicit flat imports reuse accepted registry; typed frozen decoded values detach mappings, and configured_model is distinct from role recommendations.

All nine sensitive autonomous classifications independently rejected; checked configured-catalog mismatch, broadening, traversal, foreign/overlapping ownership, unknown payloads and actual Windows junction escape. Native settings confer no binding; loaded policy and input files remain unchanged, with no credentials or authorization effects.

Handoff accurately bounds decoder/persistence/argv responsibilities and provenance, but the claimed source support and schema-valid effective-policy output omit the two reproduced failures; update alongside their bounded regressions.

findings.description: Loading the unchanged actual source installation through load_project_settings(worktree, load_installation_record(worktree)) raises invalid_input for unknown policy action local_containers. SAFE_AUTONOMOUS_ACTIONS at src/config.py:32 omits this established action; _decode_policy at line 1002 therefore rejects the current authorized .ai/project/policy.json and blocks source workflows.
findings.expected_fix: Recognize the existing local_containers action in the appropriate closed classification without changing project policy. Add a regression loading the actual source-policy shape in addition to installer defaults, and update handoff evidence.

findings.description: effective_policy(RunOverrides(max_agent_invocations=0)).to_wire() returns an invalid policy: the accepted registry rejects /max_agent_invocations because frozen policy.schema.json requires minimum 1. RunSettings and RunOverrides permit zero at src/config.py:561 and :594, and effective_policy copies it into the advertised schema-valid snapshot at :693. Persistence owners cannot use that result as the promised workflow-run.policy_ref snapshot.
findings.expected_fix: Keep configured invocation limits within the existing minimum across overrides, saved hydration and effective policy snapshots; preserve max_rewrites=0 and leave observed usage/remaining-budget facts to their owners. Validate accepted boundary snapshots through the registry and revise the zero-invocation regression/handoff. Do not change v1 schemas or project policy.
